# FEROKINZA EXPORT & IMPORT

> Italy-based sourcing, procurement and export company. We source genuine products from European manufacturers, brands, distributors and specialized suppliers, then export them worldwide — from a single spare part to a full container. No order is too small.

FEROKINZA operates from Milano, Italy. A buyer sends a requirement — a part number, a datasheet, a brand name, a photograph or a rough description — and a dedicated procurement team handles product identification, supplier sourcing, quotation, purchase, consolidation, export documentation and freight through to delivery. The buyer deals with one partner instead of a dozen suppliers.

Core specialization: European sourcing, and multi-supplier European consolidation — orders from several European suppliers collected in Europe and shipped as one consignment, on one invoice, with one set of export documents and one customs clearance.

## What we do

- [Services](https://ferokinza.com/#services): product identification, supplier sourcing, alternative solutions for discontinued or over-budget items, quotation, procurement and export
- [How it works](https://ferokinza.com/#process): five steps — you send the requirement, we source and confirm, you receive a quotation, we procure and consolidate, we export and deliver
- [Logistics & Incoterms](https://ferokinza.com/#logistics): courier (DHL/FedEx/UPS), air, sea LCL, sea FCL and road; quoted on Incoterms 2020 — EXW, FCA, FOB, CIF, CIP, DAP, DDP
- [Compliance & documentation](https://ferokinza.com/#documentation): commercial invoice and packing list with HS codes, Certificate of Origin / EUR.1, CE marking and declarations of conformity, food safety documents (health certificates, HACCP, food-grade declarations), technical datasheets and MSDS, bill of lading or air waybill, insurance certificate

## What we source

17 product categories and industry sectors, listed at [sectors](https://ferokinza.com/#sectors):

- Food & beverage — chocolate, confectionery, premium and luxury brands, beverages, packaged foods, ingredients, snacks, specialty foods
- Electrical & automation — switchgear, drives, PLCs, sensors, controls, cables, panel components
- Industrial & mechanical — pumps, motors, bearings, gearboxes, hydraulics, pneumatics, machinery parts
- Plumbing & sanitary — valves, fittings, piping systems, sanitaryware, bathroom products
- Water treatment — filtration, dosing, membranes, treatment plant equipment, consumables
- Construction materials — finishes, fixings, tools, site equipment, specified building products
- Healthcare & hospital — medical consumables, equipment, furniture, hospital supplies
- Hotel & hospitality — guest room supplies, kitchen equipment, tableware, linen, amenities
- Automotive & marine — components, spares and workshop supplies for vehicles and vessels
- Oil & gas equipment — instrumentation, flow control, fittings, field maintenance items
- Manufacturing & packaging — production line parts, packaging machinery, materials, consumables
- Safety equipment — PPE, fire safety, site protection, workplace safety products
- Agricultural products — farm inputs, equipment, irrigation, post-harvest supplies
- Energy solutions — generation, distribution, storage, efficiency equipment
- OEM parts — original components sourced against drawings, codes or sample parts
- Maintenance (MRO) — recurring maintenance, repair and operations requirements
- Project requirements — complete BOQ and specialized project lists procured as one package

Requirements outside these categories are still welcome; sourcing unusual items is part of the work.

## Markets

Sourcing base is Italy and Europe. Delivery and commercial experience covers eight regions, described at [markets](https://ferokinza.com/#markets): Europe, GCC, India, Asia, Australia, Africa, China and the USA.

## For European suppliers and brands

[Supplier partnerships](https://ferokinza.com/#suppliers): European manufacturers, brands, distributors and specialized suppliers sell to FEROKINZA on domestic terms with domestic paperwork. Export documentation, freight and the overseas customer relationship sit with FEROKINZA. Small enquiries are aggregated into consolidated orders so low-volume export demand becomes commercially viable.
